title: Rate Lock Commitment Extension Terms by Lock Product
content:
Every **Rate Lock Commitment** can be extended on the terms set for its product. The schedule states the extension cost per calendar day extended, the extension lengths the lock desk sells, the caps on extensions, the request grace and the loan file statuses in which an extension may be booked.

| Rate Lock Commitment product | Extension cost per calendar day extended (basis points of the loan amount at lock) | Extension lengths sold (days) | Maximum number of extensions | Maximum cumulative extension days | Request grace after the current expiration date (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock | 2.5 | 5, 10 | 2 | 15 | 0 |
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | 2.0 | 5, 10, 15 | 3 | 30 | 0 |
| Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | 2.0 | 5, 10, 15 | 3 | 30 | 0 |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock | 2.0 | 5, 10, 15 | 3 | 30 | 0 |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | 2.5 | 5, 10, 15 | 2 | 30 | 0 |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | 3.0 | 15, 30 | 2 | 45 | 0 |
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | 3.0 | 15, 30 | 2 | 60 | 0 |

**Terms common to every product**

- **Request grace.** The request grace is the number of calendar days after the current expiration date within which an extension request is still accepted. It is 0 for every product, which means the request must be made on or before the expiration date.
- **Loan file statuses in which an extension may be booked**: processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended and clear to close. This list is the same for every product.
- **Where the extension days are added.** Extension days are added to the current expiration date, never to the date of the request. This holds for every product.
- **When the cost is collected.** Booked extension, relock and float-down costs are collected as a price adjustment at closing rather than in advance. This holds for every product.

### Points of reading

- The cost per day is stated in basis points of the loan amount at lock. One basis point is one hundredth of a point, so 2.5 basis points per day is 0.025 points per day.
- The 120-day and 180-day locks sell extensions only in 15- and 30-day lengths. The other products sell 5- and 10-day lengths, and every product except the Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock also sells a 15-day length.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* a lock under the Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock that has used 2 extensions has reached its maximum number of extensions, even if its cumulative extension days are still below 30.
